sentences.en: And driving the car is my dear, wonderful friend, Alan.
sentences.zh: 开车的是我亲爱的、很棒的朋友，艾伦。

sentences.en: One of my favorite animals on Earth.

sentences.en: He's actually the one who introduced me to this bat poem in the first place.
sentences.zh: 其实最初就是他向我介绍了这首蝙蝠诗。

sentences.en: I hate it.

sentences.en: Not for me.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢。

sentences.zh: 我和艾伦是在20多岁时认识的，那时我们年轻、天真，还有着漂亮的蓬松头发。

sentences.en: It is true that you and I have known each other for 22 years.
sentences.zh: 你我相识22年了，这是真的。

sentences.en: But a lot has happened since then.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后发生了很多事。

sentences.en: There have been births and deaths and all kinds of big life changes.
sentences.zh: 经历了出生、死亡，还有各种各样的人生巨变。

sentences.en: Now, Alan and I live on opposite coasts.
sentences.zh: 现在，我和艾伦住在海岸的两端。

sentences.en: But we're still always talking to each other about everything.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然一直在交流关于一切的事情。

sentences.en: Including our dream of taking this big trip together.
sentences.zh: 包括我们一起去进行这次大旅行的梦想。

sentences.en: To Mexico.
sentences.zh: 去墨西哥。

sentences.en: To Mexico.
sentences.zh: 去墨西哥。

sentences.en: Which is where Alan is from.
sentences.zh: 那是艾伦的家乡。

sentences.en: Let's go down to Yucatan.
sentences.zh: 我们去尤卡坦半岛吧。

sentences.en: And now, we are here.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们到了。

sentences.en: On that trip.
sentences.zh: 在那次旅行中。

sentences.en: In the Yucatan.
sentences.zh: 在尤卡坦。

sentences.en: One of the most epic places on Earth.
sentences.zh: 地球上最史诗般的地方之一。

sentences.en: It's madness.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: This is the place where the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs hit.
sentences.zh: 这里就是导致恐龙灭绝的小行星撞击的地方。

sentences.en: That happened, like right near here.
sentences.zh: 那件事就发生在这附近。

sentences.en: Where Maya civilization rose and fell.
sentences.zh: 玛雅文明兴起又衰落的地方。

sentences.en: The reality of Mayan culture is art.
sentences.zh: 玛雅文化的本质就是艺术。

sentences.en: All of it is art.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是艺术。

sentences.en: And now, it's this wild explosion of biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 现在，这里是一场生物多样性的狂野爆发。

sentences.en: I mean, look.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你看。

sentences.en: You're right, as you can see.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，如你所见。

sentences.en: It's like lizards and toucans and monkeys and jaguars and manatees.
sentences.zh: 这里有蜥蜴、巨嘴鸟、猴子、美洲豹和海牛。

sentences.en: Manatees?
sentences.zh: 海牛？

sentences.en: You haven't seen, but you'll see.
sentences.zh: 你还没见过，但你会见到的。

sentences.en: Like, you'll see.
sentences.zh: 比如，你会看到的。

sentences.en: All animals I would love to spend time with.
sentences.zh: 所有这些动物我都乐意花时间相处。

sentences.en: But that's not why we're here.
sentences.zh: 但那不是我们来这儿的原因。

sentences.en: We have come to the Yucatan to meet an animal that I do not particularly want to spend time with.
sentences.zh: 我们来到尤卡坦是为了见一种我并不是特别想花时间相处的动物。

sentences.en: The bat.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠。

sentences.en: Because my attitude toward bats is pretty close to D.H.
sentences.zh: 因为我对蝙蝠的态度和D.H.

sentences.en: Lawrence's.
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯非常接近。

sentences.en: I am slightly embarrassed to admit they're not for me.
sentences.zh: 我很不好意思承认，它们不合我的胃口。

sentences.en: We are all driving into the unknown together.
sentences.zh: 我们都在一起驶向未知。

sentences.en: We're like, we're here for the bat.
sentences.zh: 我们就像是，我们是为了蝙蝠而来的。

sentences.en: It's a pretty uncomfortable place to be.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个让人很不舒服的地方。

sentences.en: My family actually likes to make fun of me for being afraid of bats.
sentences.zh: 我的家人其实很喜欢拿我怕蝙蝠这件事开玩笑。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a famous story in my family at the time.
sentences.zh: 是的，我家有个著名的故事。

sentences.en: Because one time a bat flew into a room I was in, and I allegedly screamed and shoved my mother-in-law out of the way.
sentences.zh: 因为有一次一只蝙蝠飞进了我所在的房间，据称我尖叫着把我岳母推开了。

sentences.en: Pushed her out of the way.
sentences.zh: 把她推开了。

sentences.en: Allegedly.
sentences.zh: 据称。

sentences.en: And just ran, went running out of...
sentences.zh: 然后就跑了，跑出了……

sentences.en: But in my defense, it's not just me.
sentences.zh: 但为自己辩解一下，不只是我这样。

sentences.en: Bats are spooky, like famously spooky.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠很吓人，是出了名的吓人。

sentences.en: They live in the dark, they can carry diseases, they bite.
sentences.zh: 它们生活在黑暗中，能携带疾病，还会咬人。

sentences.en: If you want to turn a normal house into a haunted house, you can just put some bats on it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想把一栋正常的房子变成鬼屋，只要在上面放几只蝙蝠就行了。

sentences.en: All the others, I was very drawn to all of those creatures.
sentences.zh: 其他的动物，我都被它们深深吸引。

sentences.en: And this is the first one that I will run away screaming from.
sentences.zh: 而这是第一个我会尖叫着逃跑的动物。

sentences.en: So why are we going to see it?
sentences.zh: 那我们为什么要来看它呢？

sentences.en: Because of that, no?
sentences.zh: 因为那个，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because of that.
sentences.zh: 因为那个。

sentences.en: But I didn't want to feel this way.
sentences.zh: 但我不想有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I wanted to want to understand bats.
sentences.zh: 我想去了解蝙蝠。

sentences.en: I wanted to get close to them and not run away screaming.
sentences.zh: 我想靠近它们，而不是尖叫着逃跑。

sentences.en: I wanted to give them the respect and curiosity that I have for all the rest of the animal kingdom.
sentences.zh: 我想给予它们我对待动物王国中其他成员那样的尊重和好奇心。

sentences.en: But how are you supposed to get to know a bat?
sentences.zh: 但你该怎么去了解一只蝙蝠呢？

sentences.en: Well, you find someone who knows the bats.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你得找个了解蝙蝠的人。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: And that person is Rodrigo Medellin.
sentences.zh: 那个人就是罗德里戈·梅德林。

sentences.en: Sam, very good to meet you guys.
sentences.zh: 山姆，很高兴见到你们。

sentences.en: Okay, so...
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么……

sentences.en: So Alan and I, along with my colleague Caitlin Roberts, meet up with Rodrigo and his bat team in the lobby of a very pink hotel in the tiny town of Xpujil.
sentences.zh: 所以艾伦和我，还有我的同事凯特琳·罗伯茨，在斯普希尔小镇一家非常粉红的酒店大堂里见到了罗德里戈和他的蝙蝠团队。

sentences.en: Which is in one of the more jungly parts of the Yucatan Peninsula, down south near the border with Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 那里位于尤卡坦半岛丛林茂密的部分，在南部靠近危地马拉边境的地方。

sentences.en: So the students that we have here, I have three students here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里的学生，我有三个学生在这里。

sentences.en: Rodrigo is a professor of ecology at UNAM, the big university in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈是墨西哥国立自治大学的生态学教授，那是墨西哥城的一所大学。

sentences.en: Javier, who is gathering his data for his thesis.
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，他正在为他的论文收集数据。

sentences.en: He and his students have been studying the bats of the Yucatan for years.
sentences.zh: 他和他的学生们多年来一直在研究尤卡坦的蝙蝠。

sentences.en: So we're going to take them out, we're going to process them, which means measure, weigh, see the...
sentences.zh: 所以我们要把它们抓出来，进行处理，这意味着测量、称重，看看……

sentences.en: In the nature world, especially in the bat world, Rodrigo is a real celebrity.
sentences.zh: 在自然界，尤其是在蝙蝠界，罗德里戈是个真正的名人。

sentences.en: He's actually famous for helping to save a whole species of bat from the brink of extinction.
sentences.zh: 他其实因帮助拯救了一个濒临灭绝的蝙蝠物种而闻名。

sentences.en: It's called the lesser long-nosed bat.
sentences.zh: 它叫小长鼻蝠。

sentences.en: And he's agreed to let us tag along with him and his students while they do their bat work this week.
sentences.zh: 他同意让我们这周跟随他和他的学生一起进行蝙蝠研究工作。

sentences.en: And while we're all sitting around chatting, getting to know each other...
sentences.zh: 当我们坐在一起聊天，互相了解时……

sentences.zh: 你手机锁屏上的是谁？

sentences.zh: 我注意到了罗德里戈手机锁屏上的照片。

sentences.zh: 这是幽灵食果蝠，是这个大陆上最大的蝙蝠，也是世界上最大的食肉蝙蝠。

sentences.en: How big?
sentences.zh: 有多大？

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Its body?
sentences.zh: 它的身体？

sentences.en: And how wide its wings?
sentences.zh: 那它的翼展有多宽？

sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不！

sentences.en: Almost a meter.
sentences.zh: 将近一米。

sentences.en: It is terrifying.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: If you've ever had a nightmare about a bat, this is probably what you saw.
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经做过关于蝙蝠的噩梦，这可能就是你梦见的样子。

sentences.en: It has huge, veiny ears and beady black eyes and this long snout full of murder teeth.
sentences.zh: 它有巨大的、布满血管的耳朵，黑豆般的眼睛，还有长长的吻部，满是杀戮之牙。

sentences.en: I imagine bats always just eating like little mosquitoes.
sentences.zh: 我以为蝙蝠总是吃吃小蚊子之类的。

sentences.en: Oh, not these guys!
sentences.zh: 哦，可不是这些家伙！

sentences.en: When they bite you, you really feel the bite.
sentences.zh: 当它们咬你时，你真的会感觉到那种痛感。

sentences.en: Its body is like the size of a small dog.
sentences.zh: 它的体型大概有一只小狗那么大。

sentences.en: And its wingspan is like a hawk.
sentences.zh: 而且它的翼展像鹰一样宽。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it is a hawk because the wings are very broad and he's very maneuverable.
sentences.zh: 没错，它确实像鹰，因为它的翅膀非常宽阔，而且非常灵活。

sentences.zh: 有个小问题。

sentences.en: Are bats social animals?
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠是群居动物吗？

sentences.en: And it's clear that Rodrigo just lives for bats.
sentences.zh: 很明显，罗德里戈就是为蝙蝠而活的。

sentences.en: He gets so excited telling us about this big, freaky bat.
sentences.zh: 他在向我们介绍这种巨大、怪异的蝙蝠时，显得非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And not just that bat.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是这一种蝙蝠。

sentences.en: He's excited about every bat on earth.
sentences.zh: 他对地球上的每一种蝙蝠都感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And he wants to tell us about all of them.
sentences.zh: 他想把关于它们的一切都告诉我们。

sentences.zh: 然后他飞回来，落在雌性蝙蝠身上，给它们撒上气味。

sentences.en: What they eat, where they live, how they mate.

sentences.zh: 所以他囊中那些恶心的混合物有一部分会掉在雌性蝙蝠身上。

sentences.en: He's marking his females that way.

sentences.en: What the hell?

sentences.en: Bats are gross.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠真恶心。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, guys.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，伙计们。

sentences.en: Oh, oh, my God.

sentences.zh: 我打算，我打算告诉你。

sentences.zh: 我倒想问问你，为什么你怕蝙蝠？

sentences.zh: 我不明白为什么人们会怕蝙蝠。

sentences.en: I really don't.
sentences.zh: 真的不明白。

sentences.en: You've never screamed and run away from a bat?
sentences.zh: 你从来没有因为蝙蝠尖叫着跑开过吗？

sentences.en: Me?
sentences.zh: 我？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: Never, never, never, never.
sentences.zh: 从来没有，一次都没有。

sentences.en: Rodrigo isn't only a bat scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈不仅是一位蝙蝠科学家。

sentences.en: He is a bat evangeliSt.
sentences.zh: 他还是蝙蝠的传道者。

sentences.en: I started, my first bat came into my house when I was 13 years old.
sentences.zh: 我开始接触蝙蝠，是因为我13岁那年，第一只蝙蝠飞进了我家。

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: I do the math.
sentences.zh: 我算了一下。

sentences.en: It all started when he was a tiny little kid.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于他还是个小孩子的时候。

sentences.en: He loved animals.
sentences.zh: 他热爱动物。

sentences.en: He says the first word he ever said was flamingo.
sentences.zh: 他说他说的第一个词是“火烈鸟”。

sentences.en: He told us he pronounced it gluglingo or something like that.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们他当时发音发成了“格鲁格林戈”之类的词。

sentences.en: And he was actually kind of a prodigy.
sentences.zh: 而且他其实算是个神童。

sentences.en: Rodrigo knew so much about animals that he ended up on this famous primetime game show in Mexico called El Gran Premio de los 64,000 pesos, the 64,000 peso grand prize.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈对动物了解得太多，以至于他最终登上了墨西哥著名的黄金时段游戏节目《64,000比索大奖赛》。

sentences.en: And so this little kid is on primetime TV answering every question they could throw at him about animals.
sentences.zh: 所以这个小屁孩在黄金时段的电视节目上，回答着他们能抛出的每一个关于动物的问题。

sentences.en: And a biology professor from UNAM was watching.
sentences.zh: 当时一位来自墨西哥国立自治大学的生物学教授正在看节目。

sentences.en: And he invited Rodrigo to come out with him into the field.
sentences.zh: 他邀请罗德里戈和他一起去野外考察。

sentences.en: So little Rodrigo ends up going out with scientists to study all kinds of animals.
sentences.zh: 于是小罗德里戈最终和科学家们一起去研究各种各样的动物。

sentences.en: And eventually, one of them takes him into a cave.
sentences.zh: 最终，其中一个人带他进了一个洞穴。

sentences.en: And this is when Rodrigo Medellin holds his very first bat.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，罗德里戈·梅德林第一次亲手抱住了蝙蝠。

sentences.en: He told us that the moment shook him inside.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，那一刻深深震撼了他的内心。

sentences.en: And he suddenly understood why he was here on Earth.
sentences.zh: 他突然明白了自己为何来到这世上。

sentences.en: To protect and advocate for bats.
sentences.zh: 为了保护和倡导蝙蝠。

sentences.en: Which is what he's been doing ever since.
sentences.zh: 这也是他从那以后一直所做的事情。

sentences.en: So, originally, the image of bats was positive.
sentences.zh: 所以，最初人们对蝙蝠的印象是正面的。

sentences.en: According to Rodrigo, bats are not only not disgusting or dangerous, they are beautiful and smart.
sentences.zh: 据罗德里戈所说，蝙蝠不仅不恶心也不危险，它们既美丽又聪明。

sentences.en: And because they play a crucial role in pest control and pollinating and dispersing seeds, they're also good for the world.
sentences.zh: 而且因为它们在害虫防治、授粉和传播种子方面发挥着至关重要的作用，它们对世界也是有益的。

sentences.en: But then something happened that made it negative.
sentences.zh: 但后来发生了一些事情，让这种印象变得负面了。

sentences.en: What was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Basically, they're just victims of bad PR.
sentences.zh: 基本上，它们只是糟糕公关的受害者。

sentences.en: Dracula, which is an amazing novel.
sentences.zh: 《德古拉》，那是一部了不起的小说。

sentences.en: You know, Dracula and vampires and stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，德古拉、吸血鬼之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's an unfair world.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不公平的世界。

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 说真的。

sentences.en: And it really is an unfair world.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个不公平的世界。

sentences.en: Like many animals on Earth right now, bats are in trouble.
sentences.zh: 就像现在地球上的许多动物一样，蝙蝠正处于困境中。

sentences.en: Not only for the usual reasons, like habitat loss and climate change, but for special problems all their own.
sentences.zh: 不仅是因为栖息地丧失和气候变化等常见原因，还有它们自身面临的特殊问题。

sentences.en: There are devastating diseases.
sentences.zh: 有毁灭性的疾病。

sentences.en: And they get annihilated by the big turbines at wind farMs.
sentences.zh: 它们还会被风力发电场的大型涡轮机碾碎。

sentences.en: And there's also this issue of the bad PR.
sentences.zh: 还有那个糟糕公关的问题。

sentences.en: People, like me, are afraid of bats, because of the whole flappy, spooky, bitey thing.
sentences.zh: 像我这样的人害怕蝙蝠，是因为它们那种扑腾、阴森、咬人的特性。

sentences.en: Which is then used as an excuse to do all kinds of violent, horrible things to them.
sentences.zh: 而这又被当作借口，对它们进行各种暴力、可怕的行为。

sentences.en: People poison them, or seal them up in caves, or even burn them alive.
sentences.zh: 人们毒杀它们，把它们封在洞穴里，甚至活活烧死它们。

sentences.en: But it wasn't always this way.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非一直如此。

sentences.en: Especially not here, in the Yucatan.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在尤卡坦这里。

sentences.en: In pre-Columbian times, bats had a very positive image.
sentences.zh: 在前哥伦布时期，蝙蝠的形象非常正面。

sentences.en: You see the archaeological remains, pottery, temples, etc.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到考古遗迹、陶器、寺庙等等。

sentences.en: You are going to find bats represented.
sentences.zh: 你会发现蝙蝠的形象随处可见。

sentences.en: In the culture of the Maya, this ancient civilization that thrived here for thousands of years,
sentences.zh: 在玛雅文化中，这个在这里繁荣了数千年的古老文明，

sentences.en: bats are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠无处不在。

sentences.en: In stories, in paintings.
sentences.zh: 在故事里，在绘画中。

sentences.en: They even had a month called Zots.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至有一个月叫“佐茨月”。

sentences.en: The month of Zots roughly coincides with the month of October, which is the month of happiness, and wealth, and abundance, because it's the month of harveSt.
sentences.zh: 佐茨月大致对应十月，那是幸福、财富和丰收的月份，因为那是收获的季节。

sentences.en: And in Maya mythology, bats represent a living link between our world and the underworld.
sentences.zh: 在玛雅神话中，蝙蝠代表着我们世界与冥界之间的生命纽带。

sentences.en: Death, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是死亡。

sentences.en: Your soul goes to rest, after you're dead.
sentences.zh: 你死后，灵魂会去休息。

sentences.en: And bats help you get there.
sentences.zh: 而蝙蝠会指引你到达那里。

sentences.en: The Maya called the underworld Xibalba, or the place of fear.
sentences.zh: 玛雅人称冥界为希巴尔巴，即“恐惧之地”。

sentences.en: Which, if you ask me, bats are a perfect mascot for a place like that.
sentences.zh: 如果问我，我觉得蝙蝠是那种地方的完美吉祥物。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Alright.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: So we're doing this show about animals.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在做这个关于动物的节目。

sentences.en: And every animal we've gone to has been something that I love and feel drawn to.
sentences.zh: 我们去看的每一种动物，都是我喜爱并感到亲近的。

sentences.en: And the bat is the first that I'm not drawn to, that I scream from, and I run away from.
sentences.zh: 而蝙蝠是第一个让我感到不适、让我尖叫并想逃跑的动物。

sentences.en: You are not going to run away from bats after we're done in this trip.
sentences.zh: 等这次旅行结束，你绝不会再想逃离蝙蝠了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm open to it.
sentences.zh: 我愿意尝试。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: I'll convert you.
sentences.zh: 我会让你改观的。

sentences.en: I'm absolutely convinced of that.
sentences.zh: 我对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: Conversion story.
sentences.zh: 改观的故事。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Let's try.
sentences.zh: 我们试试看。

sentences.en: Alright.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Muchas gracias for the breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢这顿早餐。

sentences.en: Gracias, señor.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，先生。

sentences.en: Alan and Caitlin and I follow Rodrigo and his students down the most pothole-y road I've ever been on.
sentences.zh: 艾伦、凯特琳和我跟着罗德里戈和他的学生们走在一条我走过最坑洼不平的路上。

sentences.en: It's the underworld trying to open up.
sentences.zh: 就像是冥界试图打开大门。

sentences.en: Into the jungle, which is just overwhelmingly dense.
sentences.zh: 进入丛林，那里茂密得令人窒息。

sentences.en: It's like a solid block of trees and vines.
sentences.zh: 就像是一块坚实的树木和藤蔓组成的墙。

sentences.en: And apparently inside of it, somewhere, is a Maya ruin called El Ormiguero, where bats live.
sentences.zh: 显然在里面某个地方，有一座叫埃尔奥米格罗的玛雅遗迹，蝙蝠就住在那里。

sentences.en: I'm just like at 10 excitement.
sentences.zh: 我的兴奋程度简直达到了10分。

sentences.en: 10 excitement.
sentences.zh: 10分的兴奋。

sentences.en: Well, no.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不。

sentences.en: There is like an animal part of me that is screaming and running away right now, even as we go there.
sentences.zh: 我内心深处有一部分动物本能正在尖叫并想逃跑，即使我们正往那儿走。

sentences.en: These are bats that Rodrigo and his team have been studying for years.
sentences.zh: 这些是罗德里戈和他的团队研究多年的蝙蝠。

sentences.en: And today they're going to check up on them.
sentences.zh: 今天他们要来看看它们。

sentences.en: Catch them and tag them and record a bunch of data.
sentences.zh: 捕捉它们，给它们贴上标签，并记录大量数据。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's so big.
sentences.zh: 它好大。

sentences.en: The temple is magnificent.
sentences.zh: 这座神庙真是宏伟。

sentences.en: I've never seen anything like it.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过这样的建筑。

sentences.en: It's this crumbling structure built out of white limestone roughly 1,500 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这是一座大约1500年前用白色石灰岩建造的崩塌结构。

sentences.en: Covered with ornate carbons.
sentences.zh: 上面覆盖着华丽的雕刻。

sentences.en: And the front door looks like a giant mouth with huge stone fangs.
sentences.zh: 前门看起来像一张巨大的嘴，长着巨大的石獠牙。

sentences.en: So when you go inside, it's like you're being swallowed.
sentences.zh: 所以当你走进去时，感觉就像被吞噬了一样。

sentences.en: You look just above and you can see the teeth of the jaguar coming down.
sentences.zh: 你抬头看，就能看到美洲豹的牙齿垂下来。

sentences.en: Rodrigo leads us up these ancient stone steps, past a no trespassing sign, right to this very dark and intimidating hole in the stone, about waist high.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈带着我们走上这些古老的石阶，经过一个禁止入内的标志，来到这个腰部高度、非常黑暗且令人胆寒的石洞口。

sentences.en: I'm putting two gloves on because the bite of this bat is really something out of the scale.
sentences.zh: 我戴上了两层手套，因为这种蝙蝠的咬合力确实非同寻常。

sentences.en: And then Rodrigo and his students get all geared up.
sentences.zh: 然后罗德里戈和他的学生们全副武装起来。

sentences.en: Ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: They put on headlamps and grab these long-handled nets and they stoop down and disappear into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 他们戴上头灯，拿起长柄网，弯下腰消失在黑暗中。

sentences.en: I'm actually helping hold up a tarp against the opening so the bats can't escape.
sentences.zh: 我正在帮忙撑起一块防水布挡住洞口，以免蝙蝠逃跑。

sentences.en: And after a little while, looking very dusty and sweaty, Rodrigo and his students pop back out.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，罗德里戈和他的学生们灰头土脸、大汗淋漓地钻了出来。

sentences.en: He's so excited he's out of breath because he's found his bats.
sentences.zh: 他兴奋得气喘吁吁，因为他找到了他的蝙蝠。

sentences.en: And he and his students are holding them in these bags, these checkered cloth bags.
sentences.zh: 他和学生们把蝙蝠装在这些袋子里，那些格子布袋。

sentences.en: They look like they're made out of tablecloths from an Italian restaurant.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是用意大利餐厅的桌布做的。

sentences.en: And the bags are all swinging and flopping around.
sentences.zh: 袋子在不停地晃动和拍打。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.en: And they carry these bags outside the temple, back down the steps, to where they've set up a little science station out on a folding table.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些袋子带出神庙，走下台阶，来到他们在一张折叠桌上搭建的小型科学工作站。

sentences.en: So we're going to process them, but I want to process first and foremost the mother.
sentences.zh: 我们要处理它们，但我首先想处理的是那只母蝙蝠。

sentences.en: And he's so excited.
sentences.zh: 他太兴奋了。

sentences.en: He tells us this is a bat he's named Big Mama.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们这只蝙蝠他取名叫“大妈妈”。

sentences.en: She's probably Big Mama.
sentences.zh: 她可能就是大妈妈。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: She knows the drill.
sentences.zh: 她知道流程。

sentences.en: Rodrigo grabs one of the squiggling bat bags and very tenderly, he reaches in and he pulls out the first bat.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈抓起一个蠕动的蝙蝠袋，非常温柔地伸手进去，掏出了第一只蝙蝠。

sentences.en: But I'm going to wait.
sentences.zh: 但我打算等等。

sentences.en: I have to say, even if you are a bat lover, this is a strange looking creature.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，即使你是蝙蝠爱好者，这看起来也是一种奇怪的生物。

sentences.en: It's called a woolly false vampire bat.
sentences.zh: 它叫毛假吸血蝠。

sentences.en: Big teeth, big ears, big eyes, and a big nose leaf.
sentences.zh: 大牙齿、大耳朵、大眼睛，还有一个巨大的鼻叶。

sentences.en: It's got fuzzy brown fur and this sort of tall pig snout called a nose leaf.
sentences.zh: 它长着毛茸茸的棕色皮毛，还有一个像猪鼻子一样高高的突起，叫鼻叶。

sentences.en: If they have this nose leaf, that means that they can carry the food in their mouth.
sentences.zh: 如果它们有这种鼻叶，就意味着它们可以叼着食物。

sentences.en: Rodrigo told us this is so they can echolocate while their mouths are full.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈告诉我们，这是为了让它们在嘴里塞满东西时也能进行回声定位。

sentences.en: They can fly around with a big rat or a mango in their mouth and still shoot these noises out of their nose leaf so they can fly through the jungle without smashing into trees.
sentences.zh: 它们可以叼着大老鼠或芒果到处飞，同时还能通过鼻叶发出这些声音，这样它们就能穿过丛林而不撞到树上。

sentences.en: So if you look at the nose leaf like that, it's a perfect segment of a parable.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你像那样观察鼻叶，它就是一个完美的抛物线片段。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: It's very directional.
sentences.zh: 它的方向性很强。

sentences.en: It's very easily directed by the bat.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠可以非常轻松地控制它的方向。

sentences.en: The bat team weighs the bat and measures its wingspan.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠团队会对蝙蝠进行称重并测量翼展。

sentences.en: And they punch out a little tissue sample from its wing.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会从它的翅膀上取下一小块组织样本。

sentences.en: Ow!
sentences.zh: 哎哟！

sentences.en: And Rodrigo puts it back in the bag.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈把它放回了袋子里。

sentences.en: And then, one by one, he pulls the other bats out of their bags.
sentences.zh: 然后，他一个接一个地把其他蝙蝠从袋子里拿出来。

sentences.en: Ow!
sentences.zh: 哎哟！

sentences.en: And the whole time they keep biting the crap out of them.
sentences.zh: 整个过程中，它们一直在狠狠地咬他们。

sentences.en: Don't bite me, don't bite me.
sentences.zh: 别咬我，别咬我。

sentences.en: And he does not seem to mind at all.
sentences.zh: 但他似乎一点也不介意。

sentences.en: He just loves these bats so much.
sentences.zh: 他就是太爱这些蝙蝠了。

sentences.en: There's blood.
sentences.zh: 有血。

sentences.en: Is that your blood or its blood?
sentences.zh: 那是你的血还是它的血？

sentences.en: I think it's mine.
sentences.zh: 我想是我的。

sentences.en: I'm standing at a distance.
sentences.zh: 我站在远处。

sentences.en: Out of one of the bags, Rodrigo pulls out a baby bat.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈从其中一个袋子里掏出了一只小蝙蝠。

sentences.en: He's a boy.
sentences.zh: 它是只雄性的。

sentences.en: Oh, he's so cute.
sentences.zh: 哦，它太可爱了。

sentences.en: It's so freaking cute.
sentences.zh: 真是可爱极了。

sentences.en: It's fresh and fuzzy.
sentences.zh: 它还很稚嫩，毛茸茸的。

sentences.en: Look at the milk.
sentences.zh: 看那些奶水。

sentences.en: It has little pink feet.
sentences.zh: 它有粉红色的小脚。

sentences.en: In the stomach.
sentences.zh: 在胃里。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And Rodrigo flips it over to show us that you can see through the baby bat's pink belly skin,
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈把它翻过来给我们看，你可以透过小蝙蝠粉红色的肚皮皮肤看到，

sentences.en: milk in its stomach that it's been nursing from its mother.
sentences.zh: 它胃里有从母亲那里吮吸来的奶水。

sentences.en: Oh, there it is.
sentences.zh: 哦，看到了。

sentences.en: Because these bats are part of a little family.
sentences.zh: 因为这些蝙蝠是一个小家庭的一部分。

sentences.en: They're a family of bats.
sentences.zh: 它们是一个蝙蝠家庭。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Big mama's baby.
sentences.zh: 大妈妈的宝贝。

sentences.en: And seeing all this just unlocks my general feeling of love for all animals.
sentences.zh: 看到这一切，我内心对所有动物的爱都被唤醒了。

sentences.en: These bats suddenly seem vulnerable and out of their element.
sentences.zh: 这些蝙蝠突然看起来既脆弱又与环境格格不入。

sentences.en: Let's take them all and put them in the shade in the temple.
sentences.zh: 我们把它们都带走，放到神庙的阴凉处吧。

sentences.en: And so when Rodrigo and his students climb back into that dark hole and put the bats back into their temple, I see the darkness a little differently.
sentences.zh: 所以当罗德里戈和他的学生们爬回那个黑暗的洞穴，把蝙蝠放回它们的神庙时，我对黑暗的看法有了些许不同。

sentences.en: It's not only a horrifying void of death.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅是一个恐怖的死亡虚空。

sentences.en: It's also just where the bats are.
sentences.zh: 它也是蝙蝠居住的地方。

sentences.en: Big mama and her fuzzy little family.
sentences.zh: 大妈妈和她毛茸茸的小家庭。

sentences.en: It's actually not even dark to the bats.
sentences.zh: 对蝙蝠来说，这里其实一点也不黑。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, it's littered with bones and guano and severed mousetails, but it's their home.
sentences.zh: 我是说，没错，这里到处都是骨头、鸟粪和断掉的老鼠尾巴，但这是它们的家。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of curious now.
sentences.zh: 我现在有点好奇了。

sentences.en: I can almost maybe sort of imagine going in there myself, into the bats world, to see the darkness with my own eyes.
sentences.zh: 我甚至可以稍微想象一下自己走进去，走进蝙蝠的世界，亲眼看看那里的黑暗。

sentences.en: Maybe tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 也许明天吧。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.zh: 我负责编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: They missed the turn?
sentences.zh: 他们错过了转弯处？

sentences.en: No, is that them?
sentences.zh: 不，那是他们吗？

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么事？

sentences.en: We're on our way to visit another bat roost with Rodrigo at a temple called Okul Weets.
sentences.zh: 我们正在前往参观另一个蝙蝠栖息地的路上，和罗德里戈一起去一座叫 Okul Weets 的神庙。

sentences.en: Was there a fire up there?
sentences.zh: 上面着火了吗？

sentences.en: And on the drive there, we see a small fire.
sentences.zh: 在开车去那里的路上，我们看到了一场小火。

sentences.en: A little bit of a fire.
sentences.zh: 一点点火光。

sentences.en: Where patches of the jungle are being cleared.
sentences.zh: 丛林中有些地方正在被清理。

sentences.en: There's tractors and white dust everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是拖拉机和白色的灰尘。

sentences.en: Oh, they cleared a huge amount of trees.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们清理了大量的树木。

sentences.en: And what we're seeing is a gigantic project that's going to change the Yucatan forever.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的是一个巨大的项目，它将永远改变尤卡坦半岛。

sentences.en: It's called Train Maya.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“玛雅火车”。

sentences.en: This railroad that will circle the whole peninsula right through the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 这条铁路将环绕整个半岛，直接穿过荒野。

sentences.en: Clear cut and leveled.
sentences.zh: 砍伐殆尽，夷为平地。

sentences.en: Breaking up habitats and supercharging development.
sentences.zh: 破坏栖息地，并加速开发。

sentences.en: Perspective of the people of Xpuhiti.
sentences.zh: 斯普希蒂人民的视角。

sentences.en: The whole thing is very controversial.
sentences.zh: 整件事非常有争议。

sentences.en: Alan told me that it's creating a lot of jobs.
sentences.zh: 艾伦告诉我，它创造了很多就业机会。

sentences.en: It's really helping the Yucatan economy.
sentences.zh: 它确实在帮助尤卡坦的经济。

sentences.en: It's hard to understand from a...
sentences.zh: 很难从一个……的角度去理解。

sentences.en: But Rodrigo is worried about the impact of all this on the wildlife here.
sentences.zh: 但罗德里戈很担心这一切对当地野生动物的影响。

sentences.en: Especially, of course, the bats.
sentences.zh: 当然，尤其是对蝙蝠。

sentences.en: We follow Rodrigo off the main road, deep into the jungle.
sentences.zh: 我们跟随罗德里戈离开主路，深入丛林。

sentences.en: And then we hike.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始徒步。

sentences.en: It's so hot right now.
sentences.zh: 现在太热了。

sentences.en: It's like a million and a half degrees.
sentences.zh: 简直有一百五十万度那么热。

sentences.en: But then we see it.
sentences.zh: 但随后我们看到了它。

sentences.en: The temple.
sentences.zh: 那座神庙。

sentences.en: 600 years of abandonment.
sentences.zh: 被遗弃了600年。

sentences.en: This one is even more ruined than the first one.
sentences.zh: 这座比第一座损毁得更严重。

sentences.en: There are jungle plants growing right out of the stones.
sentences.zh: 丛林植物直接从石头缝里长了出来。

sentences.en: It feels secluded and totally abandoned.
sentences.zh: 这里感觉与世隔绝，完全被遗弃了。

sentences.en: It's like we've slipped into some secret back pocket of the universe.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我们溜进了宇宙中某个秘密的角落。

sentences.en: And as you can see, a whole wall of the temple is missing.
sentences.zh: 正如你所见，神庙的一整面墙都不见了。

sentences.en: But the bats love it here.
sentences.zh: 但蝙蝠很喜欢这里。

sentences.en: It's shadowed.
sentences.zh: 这里有阴影。

sentences.en: It's protected.
sentences.zh: 这里有遮蔽。

sentences.en: It's cool.
sentences.zh: 这里很凉爽。

sentences.en: It's beyond the reach of any predator.
sentences.zh: 这里是任何捕食者都无法触及的地方。

sentences.en: So they love it here.
sentences.zh: 所以它们喜欢这里。

sentences.en: We all take turns peeking in there through an old doorway.
sentences.zh: 我们轮流通过一个旧门口往里窥视。

sentences.en: Whispering so we don't bother the bats.
sentences.zh: 压低声音，以免打扰到蝙蝠。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm going into the bat temple.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我要进蝙蝠神庙了。

sentences.en: The bats are up in a high corner.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠在高处的角落里。

sentences.en: They're just a cluster of dark shapes.
sentences.zh: 它们只是一团团黑色的影子。

sentences.en: Hanging upside down against the gray stone.
sentences.zh: 倒挂在灰色的石头上。

sentences.en: What is this temple?
sentences.zh: 这是什么神庙？

sentences.en: He knows them.
sentences.zh: 他认识它们。

sentences.en: Who's here?
sentences.zh: 谁在这里？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Where are they now?
sentences.zh: 它们现在在哪里？

sentences.en: They're dead and gone.
sentences.zh: 它们已经死了，消失了。

sentences.en: See the ears.
sentences.zh: 看那些耳朵。

sentences.en: Do you think they're echolocating us?
sentences.zh: 你觉得它们在对我们进行回声定位吗？

sentences.en: I know they're echolocating.
sentences.zh: 我知道它们在进行回声定位。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Oh, look.
sentences.zh: 哦，看。

sentences.en: Those two in the back.
sentences.zh: 后面那两只。

sentences.en: On the left here.
sentences.zh: 左边那两只。

sentences.en: They're getting very, very close together.
sentences.zh: 它们靠得非常非常近。

sentences.en: They're clinging to each other.
sentences.zh: 它们紧紧依偎在一起。

sentences.en: Think they love each other?
sentences.zh: 你觉得它们相爱吗？

sentences.en: Like we feel an affection, a mammal affection.
sentences.zh: 就像我们感受到的一种情感，一种哺乳动物的情感。

sentences.en: They're attached to each other.
sentences.zh: 它们彼此依附。

sentences.en: And they depend on each other for their survival.
sentences.zh: 而且它们依靠彼此生存。

sentences.en: Beyond that, I cannot tell you that they love each other.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我不能告诉你它们是否相爱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Do you think I could stand in here while you catch the bats?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我可以在你捕捉蝙蝠的时候站在这里吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: I kind of can't believe I just asked to stay in here.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信我刚才竟然要求留在这里。

sentences.en: We'll sit you there.
sentences.zh: 我们让你坐在那里。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because the bats are calm right now, but once Rodrigo starts trying to catch them...
sentences.zh: 因为蝙蝠现在很安静，但一旦罗德里戈开始尝试捕捉它们……

sentences.en: Some of them may land on you.
sentences.zh: 它们中的一些可能会落到你身上。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: ...they will not be calm.
sentences.zh: ……它们就不会那么安静了。

sentences.en: Are you okay with that?
sentences.zh: 你没问题吧？

sentences.en: Seriously?
sentences.zh: 认真的吗？

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 认真的。

sentences.en: And even though I've seen some cute bats now, I am still very afraid of them.
sentences.zh: 尽管我现在已经见过一些可爱的蝙蝠，但我仍然非常害怕它们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the teSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是考验。

sentences.en: Is that part of progress?
sentences.zh: 那是进步的一部分吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Can we call that progress?
sentences.zh: 我们可以称之为进步吗？

sentences.en: That would be incredible.
sentences.zh: 那将是不可思议的。

sentences.en: But I think just being around Rodrigo and his love for bats, it has made me curious.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，仅仅是待在罗德里戈身边，感受他对蝙蝠的爱，就让我产生了好奇心。

sentences.en: And that curiosity for this one moment just barely outweighed my fear.
sentences.zh: 而那种好奇心在这一刻，勉强战胜了我的恐惧。

sentences.en: If they land on you, just don't move.
sentences.zh: 如果它们落到你身上，别动就行。

sentences.en: Don't scream and run?
sentences.zh: 别尖叫着跑开？

sentences.en: Don't scream and run.
sentences.zh: 别尖叫，别乱跑。

sentences.en: No screaming.
sentences.zh: 不许尖叫。

sentences.en: No, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Get him off.
sentences.zh: 把他弄走。

sentences.en: Get him off.
sentences.zh: 把他弄走。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Nothing like that.
sentences.zh: 没那回事。

sentences.en: Rodrigo sits me down on this pile of rubble at the back of the chamber, and the students outside wrap the whole chamber up in tarps so we're sealed in.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈让我坐在密室后方的一堆瓦砾上，外面的学生用防水布把整个密室封了起来，我们就被关在里面了。

sentences.en: Even if I wanted to run away screaming, I couldn't.
sentences.zh: 就算我想尖叫着逃跑，也跑不掉。

sentences.en: I'm stuck here until Rodrigo is done.
sentences.zh: 在罗德里戈忙完之前，我只能困在这里。

sentences.en: And it is dark.
sentences.zh: 而且这里很黑。

sentences.en: It's cool and musty, and it smells like ancient stone.
sentences.zh: 空气凉爽而潮湿，闻起来有股古老石头的味道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: We're ready.
sentences.zh: 我们准备好了。

sentences.en: But after a minute, my eyes start to adjust, and I can just barely see the bats up in the corner, these dark shapes against the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 但过了一会儿，我的眼睛开始适应了，勉强能看到角落里的蝙蝠，那是天花板上的一团团黑影。

sentences.en: I see Rodrigo kind of sneak over and reach up his long net and try to catch a bat, and that's when the motion starts, the bat motion, the flitting and darting, you know, bat stuff.
sentences.zh: 我看到罗德里戈悄悄走过去，伸出他的长网试图捕捉一只蝙蝠，就在那时，动作开始了，蝙蝠的动作，飞来飞去，穿梭盘旋，你知道的，就是蝙蝠那一套。

sentences.en: The bats are flying around like nightmare confetti.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠飞来飞去，就像噩梦般的五彩纸屑。

sentences.en: I'm scared.
sentences.zh: 我很害怕。

sentences.en: And I'm just sitting here, frozen, trying to stay calm, dissociating.
sentences.zh: 我只是坐在那里，僵住了，试图保持冷静，让自己抽离出来。

sentences.en: And I found myself thinking, weirdly, of my father.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我发现自己想到了我的父亲。

sentences.en: Because I realized I was sitting in this dark bat chamber, and I was wearing my dad's socks, which I inherited when he died.
sentences.zh: 因为我意识到我正坐在黑暗的蝙蝠洞里，脚上穿着我父亲去世后留给我的袜子。

sentences.en: And I remembered this flash of a memory from when I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 我突然想起儿时的一段记忆。

sentences.en: It was the first time I ever saw a bat in my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我这辈子第一次见到蝙蝠。

sentences.en: After my parents got divorced, my dad used to love to take us to caves when he had us for the weekend or something.
sentences.zh: 父母离婚后，父亲周末带我们的时候，特别喜欢带我们去洞穴探险。

sentences.en: He would take us on tours or exploring on our own.
sentences.zh: 他会带我们参加旅游团，或者自己去探索。

sentences.en: It was kind of our special place outside of the normal world.
sentences.zh: 那是我们在这个正常世界之外的特殊天地。

sentences.en: And I remembered being maybe five years old and deep in this cave when suddenly there was this motion out of nowhere, and it was bats.
sentences.zh: 我记得大概五岁的时候，在洞穴深处，突然出现了一阵骚动，那是蝙蝠。

sentences.en: And one of them flew so close to my face, and I remembered seeing its teeth and the little pig nose.
sentences.zh: 其中一只飞得离我的脸特别近，我记得看到了它的牙齿和那个小猪鼻子。

sentences.en: And the funny thing is, I don't think I was scared because my father was right there with me.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我觉得我当时并不害怕，因为父亲就在我身边。

sentences.en: I was just interested.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得很有趣。

sentences.en: It actually seemed amazing that there was this whole other form of life deep down in the earth, and here we were crossing paths.
sentences.zh: 地球深处竟然还有另一种生命形式，而我们在这里不期而遇，这简直太神奇了。

sentences.en: And now 40 years later, sitting in this dark temple in the Yucatan, I was just kind of swimming
sentences.zh: 四十年后的今天，坐在尤卡坦半岛这座黑暗的寺庙里，我正沉浸在

sentences.en: in this memory when suddenly I look up, and Rodrigo and his student have caught all the bats, and
sentences.zh: 这段记忆中，突然我抬头一看，罗德里戈和他的学生已经抓住了所有的蝙蝠，

sentences.en: they're holding their little checkered bags, and the chamber is suddenly unwrapped, and the light comes flooding back in.
sentences.zh: 他们手里拿着格子布袋，密室的遮盖物被撤掉，光线重新涌了进来。

sentences.en: And we're back in the daylight.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了日光下。

sentences.en: And it occurs to me that maybe my fear of bats isn't really about bats.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到，也许我怕的不是蝙蝠本身。

sentences.en: Maybe it's more about what they represent.
sentences.zh: 也许我怕的是它们所代表的东西。

sentences.en: All the deeper, all the deeper, darker stuff, the unknown, the void, death.
sentences.zh: 那些更深、更暗的东西，未知，虚无，死亡。

sentences.en: You can't shut the door without a tree in it.
sentences.zh: 不把树移开，你就关不上门。

sentences.en: You want me to go forward a bit?
sentences.zh: 你想让我往前走一点吗？

sentences.en: And all this bat family talk, and the memories, and socks, and impermanence.
sentences.zh: 所有关于蝙蝠家族的谈话，那些记忆、袜子，还有无常。

sentences.en: It's got me thinking about my family, about my daughter, Greta, who's off at college, and my son, Beckett, who turned 16 while I was on this trip.
sentences.zh: 这让我开始思考我的家庭，我的女儿格蕾塔，她正在上大学，还有我的儿子贝克特，我在这次旅行中他刚满16岁。

sentences.en: And I didn't think it would really bother me not to be there for his birthday, but now it really does.
sentences.zh: 我本以为没能参加他的生日聚会对我没什么影响，但现在看来，影响真的很大。

sentences.en: And Alan can relate, because he found out this morning that his baby daughter, Maria, took her first steps.
sentences.zh: 艾伦也能感同身受，因为他今天早上得知他的小女儿玛丽亚迈出了人生的第一步。

sentences.en: Everything is just rushing forward without us.
sentences.zh: 一切都在我们不知不觉中飞速向前。

sentences.en: Those big milestones.
sentences.zh: 那些重要的人生里程碑。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I felt a lot of love and distance at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我同时感受到了浓浓的爱意和遥远的距离感。

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么办？

sentences.en: Your boy's all grown up.
sentences.zh: 你的孩子已经长大了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I can't even imagine.
sentences.zh: 我甚至无法想象。

sentences.en: I cannot imagine.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象。

sentences.en: It sounds devastating.
sentences.zh: 听起来太令人难过了。

sentences.en: I mean, and not, like, joyous and wonderful, and they have their lives, and then they'll come back, and you'll get, like, you know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这不像是那种充满喜悦和美好的事，他们有自己的生活，然后他们会回来，你会得到，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's all that.
sentences.zh: 是啊，确实有那些成分。

sentences.en: There's all that.
sentences.zh: 确实有那些成分。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's, like, there's the part where it's an ending, and there's the part where it's just wonderful development, and, like, if it went any different, that would be bad.
sentences.zh: 是啊，一方面这是一种结束，另一方面这又是美妙的成长，如果情况有所不同，那才糟糕呢。

sentences.en: But, yeah.
sentences.zh: 但是，确实。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Then you die.
sentences.zh: 然后你就死了。

sentences.en: And then everyone forgets that you existed.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人都会忘记你的存在。

sentences.en: And then you're, and your civilization is a big husk of ruins.
sentences.zh: 然后你，你的文明就成了一堆废墟。

sentences.en: Wait, you took it too far.
sentences.zh: 等等，你扯得太远了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想是吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我想是吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm looking at those Mayan temples, and I'm thinking, like, everything dies.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我看着那些玛雅神庙，我在想，万物皆会消亡。

sentences.en: Like, the forest, things are dying all around us, and animals are dying, and you're going to die, and both of our dads died.
sentences.zh: 就像森林，周围的一切都在死去，动物在死去，你也会死，我们俩的父亲也都去世了。

sentences.en: And, like, everyone is going to have a dead dad.
sentences.zh: 而且，每个人最终都会失去父亲。

sentences.en: Like, that's what it means to be alive, is that eventually you have a dead dad.
sentences.zh: 这就是活着的意义，最终你都会有一个去世的父亲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Unless you die firSt.
sentences.zh: 除非你先死。

sentences.en: But then there's the fact that it was, like, individual, did my individual dad, Peter Anderson, have died.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这是个人的，我的父亲，彼得·安德森，他去世了。

sentences.en: And I have to sit around thinking about that all the time, because he was my individual dad.
sentences.zh: 我不得不整天坐着想这件事，因为他是我独一无二的父亲。

sentences.en: Do you think about it a lot?
sentences.zh: 你经常想这件事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think about it every day.
sentences.zh: 是的，我每天都在想。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He was a really affectionate, sweet, kind man.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常深情、甜美、善良的人。

sentences.en: I took a bunch of his clothes after he died, and so I'm always wearing his socks or his raincoat or his fingerless gloves all winter long and all kinds of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他去世后，我拿了他很多衣服，所以整个冬天我总是穿着他的袜子、雨衣或者露指手套之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's serious.
sentences.zh: 这是认真的。

sentences.en: So I'm always thinking about him.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是想起他。

sentences.en: I think about him every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在想他。

sentences.en: We drive on through the jungle, toward our last stop with Rodrigo.
sentences.zh: 我们开车穿过丛林，前往罗德里戈行程的最后一站。

sentences.en: A very special place that the Bat team has told us is going to blow our minds.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠团队告诉我们，那是一个非常特别的地方，会让我们大开眼界。

sentences.en: And it's basically the last place I could have imagined myself going to before this trip.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是我在这次旅行前最没想过会去的地方。

sentences.en: We are 43 minutes away.
sentences.zh: 我们还有43分钟路程。

sentences.en: Because even the name of this place sounds like a horror movie.
sentences.zh: 因为光是这个地方的名字听起来就像恐怖电影。

sentences.en: It's called The Bat Volcano.
sentences.zh: 它叫蝙蝠火山。

sentences.en: We are going there after the break.
sentences.zh: 休息过后我们就要去那里。

sentences.en: Let me tell you a story about a hole.
sentences.zh: 让我给你们讲个关于洞的故事。

sentences.en: A deep, dark, intimidating hole in the earth, in the Yucatan, where thousands of years ago, the limestone collapsed, leaving this big canyon with a cave at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 在尤卡坦半岛，有一个深邃、黑暗、令人畏惧的地球裂口，几千年前，石灰岩坍塌，留下了一个底部有洞穴的大峡谷。

sentences.en: They call it the Bat Volcano.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为蝙蝠火山。

sentences.en: Welcome, guys.
sentences.zh: 欢迎，各位。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So stay on this side of the rope.
sentences.zh: 请待在绳子这边。

sentences.en: Because every night, millions of bats erupt out of this hole to fly off into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 因为每天晚上，数以百万计的蝙蝠会从这个洞里喷涌而出，飞向黑暗。

sentences.en: Tell me what we're looking at.
sentences.zh: 告诉我我们看到了什么。

sentences.en: We're looking at a gaping maw in the center of the earth.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是地球中心的一张大嘴。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're looking into the throat of planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们正注视着地球的喉咙。

sentences.en: How far down does it go?
sentences.zh: 它有多深？

sentences.en: Hard to tell.
sentences.zh: 很难说。

sentences.en: The scale of it is so big.
sentences.zh: 它的规模太大了。

sentences.en: A few hundred feet?
sentences.zh: 几百英尺？

sentences.en: Rodrigo insisted that we see the Bat Volcano.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈坚持要我们看看蝙蝠火山。

sentences.en: Ten miles?
sentences.zh: 十英里？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: He wanted us to feel not just what it's like to see a few bats, or a family of bats,
sentences.zh: 他想让我们感受的不仅仅是看到几只蝙蝠或一个蝙蝠家族，

sentences.en: but to be completely outnumbered, fully immersed in bats.
sentences.zh: 而是被蝙蝠彻底淹没，完全沉浸在蝙蝠的世界里。

sentences.en: Plus, there's a whole crowd of other people, because this place is kind of a tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 而且，这里还有一大群人，因为这个地方算是个旅游景点。

sentences.en: It's still light outside, so nothing has started yet.
sentences.zh: 外面天还没黑，所以还没开始。

sentences.en: We're just staring down, waiting.
sentences.zh: 我们只是盯着下面看，等待着。

sentences.en: I think this is going to be impressive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会很壮观。

sentences.en: It feels like the Bat capacity for this cave is large.
sentences.zh: 感觉这个洞穴的蝙蝠容量很大。

sentences.en: And then the sky clouds over, and it starts to rain on us.
sentences.zh: 接着天空阴了下来，开始下雨了。

sentences.en: It's a real tropical downpour.
sentences.zh: 这是一场真正的热带大雨。

sentences.en: There's no shelter, so we're just standing there getting soaked.
sentences.zh: 没有遮蔽处，我们只能站在那里淋雨。

sentences.en: And I ask Rodrigo, is the rain going to stop the bats from flying?
sentences.zh: 我问罗德里戈，雨会阻止蝙蝠飞行吗？

sentences.en: And he says, absolutely nothing will stop these bats from flying.
sentences.zh: 他说，绝对没有任何东西能阻止这些蝙蝠飞行。

sentences.en: So we stand there, sopping wet, waiting.
sentences.zh: 于是我们站在那里，浑身湿透，等待着。

sentences.en: Oh, there we go.
sentences.zh: 哦，开始了。

sentences.en: First bat.
sentences.zh: 第一只蝙蝠。

sentences.en: And finally, we see the tiniest little flitting in this giant bowl of the canyon.
sentences.zh: 终于，我们看到峡谷这个巨大的碗里出现了一丝极其微小的飞动。

sentences.en: It's almost nothing, just a speck of motion.
sentences.zh: 几乎什么都看不见，只是一个移动的小点。

sentences.en: You can see them.
sentences.zh: 你能看到它们了。

sentences.en: And then a couple more specks.
sentences.zh: 然后又多了几个点。

sentences.en: And then a few more.
sentences.zh: 接着又多了几个。

sentences.en: They're thickening.
sentences.zh: 它们变得密集了。

sentences.en: It's thickening.
sentences.zh: 越来越密集了。

sentences.en: It's sort of like watching popcorn hop.
sentences.zh: 有点像看爆米花跳动。

sentences.en: Getting really close.
sentences.zh: 越来越近了。

sentences.en: There's like one kernel, and then two, and then all of a sudden, a million kernels.
sentences.zh: 先是一粒，然后两粒，突然间，变成了一百万粒。

sentences.en: They're passing through you.
sentences.zh: 它们正穿过你的身体。

sentences.en: But these are bats, just infinite bats coming out.
sentences.zh: 但这些是蝙蝠，无穷无尽的蝙蝠涌了出来。

sentences.en: This is another species that is...
sentences.zh: 这是另一个物种，它是……

sentences.en: Different sizes, different species.
sentences.zh: 大小不同，物种也不同。

sentences.en: Short and broad wings.
sentences.zh: 翅膀短而宽。

sentences.en: But they're all sort of moving together, like this huge superorganism.
sentences.zh: 但它们都在一起移动，就像一个巨大的超级有机体。

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: They're just really getting thicker and thicker over on that side.
sentences.zh: 它们在那边变得越来越密集了。

sentences.en: And soon, the whole universe is bats.
sentences.zh: 很快，整个宇宙都是蝙蝠。

sentences.en: It's really hypnotic.
sentences.zh: 这真的很催眠。

sentences.en: I feel completely dwarfed.
sentences.zh: 我感到自己极其渺小。

sentences.en: They're coming really close to my head.
sentences.zh: 它们离我的头非常近。

sentences.en: And in that moment, I feel the strangest feeling.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我产生了一种最奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: Do you feel scared?
sentences.zh: 你感到害怕吗？

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: You feel scared?
sentences.zh: 你感到害怕吗？

sentences.en: It's absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: I think it's extremely delicate and beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它极其精致且美丽。

sentences.en: It's really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 真的很美。

sentences.en: I feel soothed by the bats.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠让我感到平静。

sentences.en: I'm not scared at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不害怕。

sentences.en: Bats are passing right in front of my face, through my legs.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠就在我面前飞过，穿过我的双腿之间。

sentences.en: They're shooting through the tiny space between me and Alan.
sentences.zh: 它们从我和艾伦之间狭小的空间里穿梭而过。

sentences.en: It's really cold.
sentences.zh: 真的很冷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And there's a crowd of people around us watching, and we are all completely silent.
sentences.zh: 周围围满了观看的人群，我们所有人都保持着绝对的安静。

sentences.en: There's this reverence in the air.
sentences.zh: 空气中弥漫着一种敬畏感。

sentences.en: I don't know how many thousands, or tens of thousands, or hundreds of thousands of bats flew right by me that night, within arm's reach.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那天晚上有多少只蝙蝠从我身边飞过，成千上万，甚至几十万只，近在咫尺。

sentences.en: None of these bats ever came close to touching me.
sentences.zh: 这些蝙蝠没有一只碰到我。

sentences.en: But I could feel their attention on me.
sentences.zh: 但我能感觉到它们对我的关注。

sentences.en: And I felt this absolute sense of truSt.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了一种绝对的信任感。

sentences.en: All I had to do was stand there and watch.
sentences.zh: 我所要做的就是站在那里观察。

sentences.en: And these millions of bat wings flapping.
sentences.zh: 还有那数百万只蝙蝠拍打翅膀的声音。

sentences.en: It sounded like rain, which reminded me of Oregon, where I'm from, where my dad lived.
sentences.zh: 听起来像雨声，这让我想起了我的家乡俄勒冈州，我父亲曾住在那儿。

sentences.en: And then, out of the silence, I hear a tiny voice calling out.
sentences.zh: 然后，在寂静中，我听到一个细小的声音在呼唤。

sentences.en: A little girl calling for her papa, which is what I called my dad, papa.
sentences.zh: 一个小女孩在叫她的爸爸，这也是我叫我父亲的方式，爸爸。

sentences.en: And I thought about all the bats we'd seen, and the bat families, holding each other,
sentences.zh: 我想到了我们见过的所有蝙蝠，还有那些蝙蝠家庭，它们彼此依偎，

sentences.en: huddling together close, hanging from the ceiling like a bunch of bananas.
sentences.zh: 紧紧挤在一起，像一串香蕉一样挂在天花板上。

sentences.en: And then I thought how, in my own tiny life, surrounded by all this depth and darkness that
sentences.zh: 然后我想，在我自己渺小的一生中，被所有这些我永远无法理解的深邃与黑暗所包围，

sentences.en: I'll never understand, all I really want to do, while I'm still here, is just hang like a bunch of bananas close to all of the creatures that I love.
sentences.zh: 我真正想做的，是在我还在世的时候，就像一串香蕉一样，紧紧挂在我所爱的所有生物身边。

sentences.en: My friend Alan, my little family, Walnut, until one of these days, maybe soon, maybe a long time from now, the darkness will take me.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友艾伦，我的小家庭，核桃，直到某一天，也许很快，也许很久以后，黑暗会将我带走。

sentences.en: And I will spread my wings and fly off into some other world that I don't understand.
sentences.zh: 我将展开双翅，飞向另一个我无法理解的世界。

sentences.en: And, at least at this moment, standing on the edge of this giant hole,
sentences.zh: 而且，至少在这一刻，站在这个巨大洞穴的边缘，

sentences.en: immersed in this living cloud of bats, that actually sounds just fine.
sentences.zh: 沉浸在这片活生生的蝙蝠云中，这听起来其实挺好的。
